# Project catalogue
The evidence-backed assessment of every declared submodule; this catalogue is not the parent README or an approved showcase.
**Creativity and current-usefulness ratings are disputed.** They are retained as draft evidence, not a trusted ranking; see the [owner calibration and proposed rubric](../../product/catalogue-calibration.md). No full rescore has been applied.
[Rubric](../../method/catalogue.md) · [Public comparisons](../catalogue-comparison.md)
Coverage: **73 projects**; **70 retain**, **3 undecided**, **0 remove candidates**.
Scores are ordinal 0–4; ? means unknown, not zero. Expected usefulness is conditional on completing the stated scope; delivery likelihood is separate.
These are source-inspected judgements, not fresh runtime, visual, security or experimental verification. Showcase candidates are a verification queue, not approved public features. Private projects are represented only by sanitized structural summaries.
Click an assessment to read score reasons, confidence, revision-bound evidence, OR-route decisions and the next decisive step. No average score decides membership.

## Validation and regeneration
Run `python3 scripts/catalogue.py --check` from the parent root to check coverage, schema, current pins/HEADs, local evidence-file existence and generated consistency.
Run `python3 scripts/catalogue.py --render` after editing assessment sources to regenerate this view; `--self-test` exercises safe failing fixtures without touching real records.
Mechanical checks do not establish that a locator supports a claim, that code works, or that a comparison is exhaustive. Parent inspection supplies bounded semantic calibration; no independent acceptance is claimed.
